recent.text: Eichel talked about this frustration a bit after the game. Said he has high expectations for himself and that’s a good thing, but things haven’t been going lately. At times he feels like he’s close to snapping out of it. At others, he doesn’t. He’s been through this, and will
recent.author: Jesse Granger
recent.quoted_text: Jack Eichel was visibly frustrated after accidentally clearing the puck out of the zone on the power play. He has only 3 points at even strength over the last 12 games. A rare rough patch for him.

recent.text: Final, 4-3 Dallas in the shootout. #VGK drop both games against the Stars. Vegas is winless in four-straight games. Postgame Observations. - The power play is most dangerous when setting up Victor Olofsson is the go-to play. - Trevor Connelly was the Golden Knights most
recent.author: Ryan The Hockey Guy

recent.text: Thomas Harley ties it. I’m not 100% sure but I *think* Parker Wotherspoon got a stick on it with a stick that was *way* above the crossbar. 3-3 https://t.co/6qn79BtXJG
recent.author: Hannah Kirkell

recent.text: Braeden Bowman fires wide. #VGK loses 4-3 in a shootout to Dallas. They had a third period lead for the second time in three days and couldn't get the job done. Instead, they've now lost four straight heading on the road.
recent.author: Danny Webster

recent.text: Dallas wins it 2-1 in the shootout. Trevor Connelly scored his attempt for Vegas, but Robertson and Seguin both scored for the Stars. That's 4 straight losses for the Golden Knights.
recent.author: Jesse Granger
